solutionSql:
SELECT w.name AS warehouse, COUNT(e.id)::integer AS arrivals
FROM warehouses AS w
LEFT JOIN routes AS r ON r.destination_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.route_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN shipment_events AS e ON e.shipment_id = s.id AND e.status = 'arrived'
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY w.name;
ambiguities: The blank is read as the status text arrived. The event statuses in the data are arrived, booked, loaded and delivered, so arrived is the only fit.
Shipments whose route ends there is read as routes.destination_id.
Every warehouse has arrivals in all three datasets, so the zero-count case the ticket asks for is not exercised by any dataset.
notes: Blank filled with arrived; the rest of the starter is unchanged. The per-warehouse counts sum to the arrived-event count on all three datasets (218, 109, 163). The sample has four warehouses, so the first-five-rows field holds four rows.
